name: Philips 55PUS7503
summary: Turn off Philips promo rows, usage logging, the store demo app and Google recommendation rows on the Philips 55PUS7503. Free phone app, backup, one-tap undo.
intro: The Philips 55PUS7503 is a 2018 model on Android TV 8. It ships with a store demo app, Philips usage logging, and a NetTV recommendation row called Top Picks. It also has Google's recommendation engines and first-run tutorials, which add rows to the home screen.

The list was checked on a real TV. The replacement home screen, Netflix, HDMI 1 to 4, component video and Live TV all worked, and the turned-off apps stayed off across standby and overnight use. The notes call it a draft that still needs a longer test. TidyTV turns these apps off from a phone on the same Wi-Fi, after saving a backup. Nothing is uninstalled.
keep: Firmware updates, Ambilight and Hue, and DLNA
The remote, Bluetooth and the Philips settings
Live TV, HDMI and the tuner services, so inputs keep working
notes: Two analytics services stay on here: Philips' candeebug and gel. They are left on until they have been tested on this older software.
If the ADB authorisation prompt does not appear, restart the TV fully, not standby. Then go back to the Android home screen and connect again.
